questions.questionTextEn: With reference to pulse production in India, consider the following statements: 1. Black gram can be cultivated as both kharif and rabi crop. 2. Green-gram alone accounts for nearly half of pulse production. 3. In the last three decades, while the production of kharif pulses has increased, the production of rabi pulses has decreased. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2020] With reference to pulse production in India, consider the following statements: 1. Black gram can be cultivated as both kharif and rabi crop. 2. Green-gram alone accounts for nearly half of pulse production. 3. In the last three decades, while the production of kharif pulses has increased, the production of rabi pulses has decreased. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) 1 only. Urad is tropical climate crop, it is a kharif crop in North India and both Rabi and Kharif season crop in South India. Production of Moong in the year 2016-17 is 14 of the total pulses. The percentage remains around the same in other years also. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2020]

questions.questionTextEn: Which among the following products is not usually exported from India?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S.(Pre) 2013 ; U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2013] Which among the following products is not usually exported from India?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Pulses. India has to import pulses despite being a leading producer due to the high rate of consumption. Thus, pulses are generally not exported from India whereas wheat, rice and sugar is exported at times. [U.P.P.C.S.(Pre) 2013 ; U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2013]

questions.questionTextEn: Assertion (A) : India has a shortage of pulses, but not of protein. Reason (R) : There is a priority in demand of pulses. In the reference of the above, which of the following is correct :
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2009] Assertion (A) : India has a shortage of pulses, but not of protein. Reason (R) : There is a priority in demand of pulses. In the reference of the above, which of the following is correct :
optionsEn: (A) and (R) both are correct, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
(A) and (R) both are correct, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
optionsHi: (A) and (R) both are correct, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
(A) and (R) both are correct, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) (A) and (R) both are correct, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).. India has a shortage of pulses but there is no shortage of sources of protein. Therefore, both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A). [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2009]

questions.questionTextEn: The type of crop which is able to fix nitrogen from the air is :
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2006] The type of crop which is able to fix nitrogen from the air is :
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Legumes. Legumes are quite unique among other crops as they draw their nitrogen from the air with the help of a specialized bacteria. So it does not require the same application of nitrogen fertilizer like other crops. [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2006]

questions.questionTextEn: Which nutrient is considered essential for growing pulse crop ?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Spl) (Mains) 2004] Which nutrient is considered essential for growing pulse crop ?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Cobalt. Cobalt is known to be essential for symbiotic nitrogen fixation by Rhizobium. Cobalt is also needed in the synthesis of vitamin B12. It is necessary for growth, photosynthesis and evaporation. [U.P.P.C.S. (Spl) (Mains) 2004]
